استنسخوا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْسَخُوا (istansaḵū) /is.tan.sa.xuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْسَخَ (istansaḵa)
# اُسْتُنْسِخُوا (ustunsiḵū) /us.tun.si.xuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْسَخَ (istansaḵa)
# اِسْتَنْسِخُوا (istansiḵū) /is.tan.si.xuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْسَخَ (istansaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
